fsm_hints: ESM and on-the-fly engine are implementable as small synchronous state machines clocked at the wire rate. FMMU lookup is a sorted-window compare against the 8 entries; SyncManager arbitration is single-buffer per channel. DC PI loop converges within 100-1000 cycles.
anti_deadlock_rule: ESM transitions only on MainDevice request via AL Control 0x0120 with one exception: PD Watchdog expiry forces Op → SafeOp. SubDevice never escalates state autonomously beyond the safe direction. Mailbox handshake on SM0/SM1 is atomic on the wire; a half-completed mailbox write cannot be observed by the SubDevice CPU. The on-the-fly engine has no internal queues; one frame in, one frame out, deterministic latency.
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: BMCR Reset (0.15 = 1) or PHY power-on: PHY clears BMCR + BMSR to defaults; AutoNeg Enable (0.12) defaults to 1 if the PHY supports AutoNeg, else 0. PHY runs the AutoNeg state machine (if enabled), then on completion the negotiated PMA / PMD takes the link to Link Up and BMSR bit 1.5 + bit 1.2 are set. The MAC is held in RX_IDLE / TX_IDLE until the MAC client and the PHY both signal Link Up.

default_ready_state_recommendation.TX_idle: TX_EN = 0; TXD = 0x0; TX_ER = 0; PHY in normal-IDLE on the medium (e.g. continuous /I/ /I/ idle code-groups for 100BASE-TX, or no FLP between AutoNeg bursts).
default_ready_state_recommendation.RX_idle: RX_DV = 0; RXD = 0x0; RX_ER = 0; CRS = 0; COL = 0. PHY's receiver still tracks line activity to assert CRS / generate False Carrier.
default_ready_state_recommendation.MDIO_idle: MDC running; MDIO line idle-high (1.5 kΩ PHY pull-up) — no STA driver active.

configurations.name: Half-duplex 10BASE-T / 100BASE-TX
configurations.description: CSMA/CD; CRS + COL active; backoff on collision; max 1 collision domain per shared segment / repeater hub.

configurations.name: Full-duplex 10/100/1000 Mb/s switched
configurations.description: No CSMA/CD; independent TX + RX; CRS / COL ignored; PAUSE-frame flow control.

configurations.name: 1000BASE-T MASTER / SLAVE
configurations.description: 1000BASE-T PHY pair runs a Master/Slave configuration (resolved by reg 9 manual setting or AutoNeg); master sources the symbol clock, slave recovers it; full-duplex on all 4 pairs simultaneously.

configurations.name: MDIO single-PHY / multi-PHY
configurations.description: PHYAD = 00000 always responds (single-PHY); multi-PHY topologies require unique PHYAD per device with the STA driving the MDC + MDIO bus to all of them.

configurations.name: Clause 22 management
configurations.description: 32 × 16-bit register file per PHY; mandatory BMCR + BMSR + PHY ID + ANAR / ANLPAR + ANER.

configurations.name: Clause 45 MMD management
configurations.description: 32 × 32 × 65 536 register file per PHY for gigabit / 10G / EEE / TPS-1 — two-cycle address-then-data MDIO protocol.

timing_dependency_rule: MII TX path is synchronous to TX_CLK (PHY-sourced, 25 MHz @100 Mb/s or 2.5 MHz @10 Mb/s). MII RX path is synchronous to RX_CLK (PHY-sourced, may be recovered from received data or a nominal clock). Per Clause 22.2.2.2, RX_CLK and TX_CLK are NOT required to maintain any guaranteed phase relationship. GMII TX path is synchronous to GTX_CLK (MAC-sourced, 125 MHz); GMII RX path is synchronous to RX_CLK (PHY-sourced, 125 MHz). MDC is asynchronous with respect to TX_CLK and RX_CLK; the MDC frequency may differ from any data-path clock.

fsm_states_esm.description: Initial state after power-up; no mailbox, no process-data.
Pre-Operational — mailbox SMs (SM0/SM1) active; CoE/SoE/EoE/FoE/AoE exchangeable.
Safe-Operational — process-data SMs and FMMUs active; Inputs valid; Outputs in Safe state.
Operational — full bidirectional cyclic process-data; PD WD armed.
Bootstrap — firmware update via FoE; only from Init.

fsm_states_esc_on_the_fly_engine.description: No frame on any port; ESC waits.
SOF detected; receive into shift register.
If addressed: read+modify+write on in-flight bytes.
If successful: increment WKC (+1 read, +2 write, +3 RW).
Transmit modified frame on next active port (or loop back).

fsm_states_mainDevice_cyclic_engine.description: BRD AL Status sweep + APRD enumeration (Position).
APWR Configured Station Address on each SubDevice.
FPWR DL Control, SM0/SM1 (mailbox), DC RX-Latch enable.
FPWR SM2/SM3, FMMU0..2, DC SYNC config.
Cyclic LRD/LWR/LRW + ARMW (DC) + BRD AL Status.
WKC drop / AL Status error / link loss → diagnose + recover.

fsm_states_mailbox_handshake.description: MainDevice FPWR into SM0; hardware sets Mbx_Out Empty=1.
SubDevice CPU reads SM0, processes, writes SM1.
Hardware sets Mbx_In Full=1; MainDevice FPRD reads SM1.
On timeout MainDevice resends with incremented Counter.

fsm_states_distributed_clocks.description: BWR 0x0900 latches RX timestamps; FPRD sweeps.
MainDevice writes System Time Offset (0x0920) + Delay (0x0928).
Cyclic ARMW; SubDevices close PI loop on local System Time.
